kind: bounded retained cell-to-point CPU/allocation diagnostic against correct committed baseline
methodology: Identical release probe source and dependency locks, separate baseline/candidate target directories. Baseline compiles without candidate API feature; candidate compiles with candidate feature. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice (four fresh processes/version); separate allocator-instrumented builds. No agent-owned builds/checks ran during measurement. One warmup then five blocks/case, eight calls/block for single cold/prepared conversions, 64 for primed latest-field hits, four for batches. Aggregate CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID and wall time cover each block; summaries normalize by call count. Output Vec capacity is allocated before timing; push, returned dataset metadata clones and conversion allocations are timed. Output destruction, source construction, validated view creation for singles, correctness checks and warm plan/cache creation are excluded. prepare_and_convert includes geometry preparation but excludes validation; prepared excludes geometry preparation; cache_hit additionally excludes initial conversion and charges retained numeric/mask payload separately. Batch compares three raw sequential s/v/s calls (including repeated validation) to one validation plus a new plan and convert_fields. Batch preparation and destruction of the plan are included; returned output destruction is excluded. Checks require identical output names, masks and every component bit versus the correct legacy result; independent exact Fraction fixtures separately qualify arithmetic. Shapes scalar/vector/tensor/complex; grids 8/24 cubed points; uniform and dyadically stretched x geometry; positive/mixed quantized/full 53-bit fields. No masks or mixed topology in timing fixtures; those use regression tests. Timings exercise the core batch used by Python, not JSON parse/serialize or end-to-end Python latency. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal state. Process CPU is not energy; cumulative allocation is not peak/live/RSS, and retained payload excludes source/output ownership and metadata. No mobile, whole-frame or whole-platform acceptance claim.
verification_note: Cache-only payload release assertions were extended after measurement and passed the six prepared-conversion tests plus strict Clippy. Production hashes remain identical to the measured source.
